title: Choose plain Git worktrees when the runtime cannot remove its own

rubric.text: Creates #90's worktree as a plain Git worktree with `git worktree add -b cb/issue-90-<slug> <path> <verified-base-sha>` because the runtime cannot remove managed worktrees, and verifies its branch and HEAD.
Gives #90 its own worktree rather than reusing a pooled slot or another ticket's worktree.
Records branch, base SHA and checkout ID (null for a plain Git worktree) in the run record and markers, never the local path.

After restart, locates the worktree by its branch in `git worktree list --porcelain`, verifies HEAD against the PR head or recorded base, and treats a worktree with no live claim or verified marker as foreign and untouched.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
